description: The ACTIVE PRISM chat fleet — the primary domain slots currently operated (NOT all 26 NATO slots). Single source of truth for fleet-wake-sequencer.mjs, fleet-orchestrate.mjs, and the Hermes/ZULU orchestrator. Read this file; never hard-code the roster in code (it rots).
notes: golf is the fleet-reaper/hygiene slot — front-loaded on every wake sweep so the reaper is never the slot that gets skipped.

The remaining 9 NATO slots (november, papa, quebec, sierra, tango, uniform, victor, yankee, zulu) are NOT in the active rotation as of this file's date. zulu/zebra is the slot-less Hermes orchestrator, not a worker.
To change the active roster, edit activeSlots here — do NOT edit code. fleet-wake-sequencer.readActiveFleet() reads this at runtime and falls back to this same list only if the file is unreadable.
